description: A Minecraft mod that adds a specialized HUD for boats

mods.name: BoatHud
mods.description: This mod adds a racing style HUD, configurable, for riding a boat, and is designed mostly for racing boats on ice.

releases.notes:
This is a bug fix update for BoatHud, and contains fixes to run the mod in Minecraft 26.2. There are no additional features or changes to existing ones.

This version was compiled against Minecraft 26.2, and requires Fabric Loader (or equivalent) Fabric API (or equivalent), and Cloth Config API.

releases.notes:
This is a major update to BoatHud and contains the following changes:

- Added look-ahead camera and respective options. This behavior is disabled by default.
- Update mappings from Fabric Yarn to Mojang official mappings, to no change in gameplay.

Enabling the look-ahead camera will have your player character look closer on the direction that the boat they ride travels in, and is disabled by default. There are settings which you can change to make the look-ahead behavior closer to your preferences. This feature was added in response to [bstn's original implementation](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/boatcam) becoming outdated and unusable in relation to Minecraft itself. Thank you so much for the experience provided over the years!

This version was compiled against Minecraft 1.21.6 and is compatible up to Minecrat 1.21.11, and requires Fabric Loader (or equivalent), Fabric API (or equivalent) and Cloth Config.
